title: Codex Dock Projection Row Envelope
description: Identity fields every relay projection row must carry before any view-specific payload fields. This is the shared contract for Dock, Archive, and Thread Detail rows.

displayOrderKey.description: Relay projection display order key. Clients render by this key and never re-sort from body timestamps or local arrival order.

revision.description: Per-row projection revision. Thread Detail requires this; Dock card rows may omit it until they carry per-row revision state.
